God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

translations.web: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
translations.bsb: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
translations.kjv: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
translations.asv: Because of his strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.
